description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Awoken Stoic Sunglasses], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode II (Lightning, Earth)] and [Deeds Not Words Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Stoic Sunglasses
description.text: Unlimited Earth and Lightning hones, Earth and Lightining abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Deeds Not Words Mode
description.text: Casts Let's Get to Work (Lightning/Earth) after using two Earth or Lightning abilities if the triggering ability deals Lightning/Earth damage

description.name: Let's Get to Work (Earth/Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Lightning] if triggering ability deals Earth/Lightning damage, grants [BLK +30% Boost 1]/[BLK +50% Boost 1] if MAG > ATK, otherwise grants [PHY +30% Boost 1]/[PHY +50% Boost 1] if Reno, Elena or Tifa are not alive/alive

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%
